## What's new in 1.21.4

- Fixed: in a contact's notes, the text cursor no longer jumps back when you pause right after typing a space. The previous fix only covered part of the problem. Thanks again for the detailed report.
- Fixed: quick capture (Ctrl+Alt+A) now opens normally while the Focus mini player is shown. The mini player no longer takes the keyboard when it appears.

## Install

Download `Aqueli_1.21.4_x64-setup.exe` below and run it. It installs Aqueli for your Windows user account, without administrator rights, and keeps your data from the previous version.

The installer is not code-signed yet: if Windows SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC", choose More info, then Run anyway.
